reason: Primary purpose is user-facing workflow automation for DeepSeek Harness approvals: the plugin adds an Auto approve permission preset and provides command/UI controls to switch approval mode, with logic to auto-respond to approval requests based on selected policy. The plugin is therefore classified as automation rather than code generation, security tooling, or data processing.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批模式，通过会话控制和 `/auto-approve` 命令在 off、sandbox 或 all 模式下处理权限请求。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an Auto approve mode to DeepSeek Harness, providing session controls and a `/auto-approve` command to handle approval requests in off, sandbox, or all modes.

capabilities: Automatic approval control for permission requests
Adds an auto-approve preset to the permission selector
Supports mode switching via `/auto-approve` command and session control
Can grant all approval requests in `all` mode

reasons.code: README describes that the plugin "auto-grants approval requests" and adds an "Auto approve" preset.
README states approval handling intercepts `approval/request` and can return allowed responses for sandbox-matched or all modes.
package.json indicates a web DSH plugin with client/runtime injection and patching support, showing it runs inside the approval flow.
